name: Rogue Blackwood
source:
A cunning hunter with enhanced senses, Rouge always find his mark. But when he loses his sister, he turns to the greatest hunt of his life: bringing her back. Rouge's loyalty knows no bounds and he will do anything, even cross realms, to protect the ones he loves.

[From [url=https://fictif.fandom.com/wiki/Rogue_Blackwood]FictIf Wiki[/url]]
